openingMessage: No one's ever drowned in sweat.
openingWhy: Nobody in this field ever got hurt by the second gas test, the extra walk-around, or the re-check that turned out to be unnecessary. That side of the ledger has no casualties. Every name on the other side of it saved himself a little effort.
leadershipThought: Breaking containment is where small mistakes turn into big consequences. Preparation, awareness, and discipline to stop work keep people safe.
